title: How-To Geek (2010): Make a book from Wikipedia articles

steps.quote: In the left sidebar, under "**Print/export**," click "**Create a book**."
steps.text: In the left sidebar, under "Print/export," click "Create a book."
steps.goal: Wikipedia's Book creator page is shown

steps.quote: On the Book creator page, click "**Start book creator**."
steps.text: On the Book creator page, click "Start book creator."
steps.goal: The book creator is on, offering to add the current page to a book
